name: com.factorweave/mcp
title: Factor Weave
description: Quant-factor data for 14,684 tickers across equities, ETFs, indices, FX, crypto and futures — factor scores, vector similarity, leak-free forward-return labels, cross-asset regime conditioners, VX term structure, and risk-coherence analogues. A research substrate, not a return-prediction service.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer fw_live_… API key (free at factorweave.com) or an OAuth 2.1 access token. MCP tools work on HOBBY tier and above; anonymous clients can still call initialize / tools/list / get_manifest.
